value.rationale: A complete genuine equivariant homotopy model valid for all strongly connected digraphs is a structural strengthening of their known ordinary sphere type. It gives every subgroup fixed-space homotopy type by a simple orbit count, proves a uniform integral sign character, and determines all rational quotient homology. These are natural equivariant invariants not implied by a nonequivariant sphere count.
